findings.claim: content/write append concatenates raw bytes (spike 2 expected MAP_V2 + MAP_APP), and the skill's append line has no leading newline. If the model writes the seed without a trailing newline, which the fenced block does not make explicit, the first new root ends up on the clips/ line. The map then no longer has one root per line. Fix: start the appended content with a newline, or say the seed ends with one.
